retrievalProfile.description: A stark, two-tone graphic portrait style featuring heavy black shadows against a solid warm neutral background with bold, wide-set typography.
excludeWhen: soft gradients or realistic skin tones are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition centered on a high-contrast, posterized portrait where all mid-tones are removed, leaving only solid black shadows and a single background color. The subject is framed from the chest up, with typography placed in the corners to balance the asymmetrical weight of the figure.
coreVisualRelationships: Figure-ground relationship defined by extreme tonal contrast
Asymmetrical balance between the subject's head and the negative space
Typographic weight mirroring the density of the black shadows
Text placement anchoring the top-left and bottom-right corners
coreInvariants: Strict two-color palette (black and one warm neutral)
Complete absence of gradients or halftones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is slightly off-center, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast face and eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left text, down the diagonal of the subject's arm and face, to the large text at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid background color provides breathing room in the upper left and around the head.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for shadows and figure
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background with maximum value contrast against black.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and colors to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square geometric feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary horizontal presence and blocky structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, two-tone posterized portrait of a man in a black shirt against a solid tan background. The image should have no gradients, only solid black and solid tan areas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, extended sans-serif text in the top-left corner in black, and larger extended sans-serif text in the bottom-right corner in the background tan color, knocked out of the black shirt area.

verificationChecks: Is the palette limited to exactly two colors?
Is the portrait high-contrast with no mid-tones?
Is the typography extended and heavy?
Is the bottom text knocked out of the black shadow area?

mustAchieve: Stark graphic separation between light and dark
Clean, sharp edges on all shapes

postGenerationChecks: Check for any stray gray pixels or gradients.
Ensure text is perfectly horizontal and aligned to corners.
Verify the 'knockout' effect on the bottom text is clean.
Confirm the subject's features are recognizable despite the high contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast posterization + solid neutral background + extended geometric sans-serif typography in opposing corners.
